## Change

Explain the problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue, if any.

## Validation

List commands run, results, and checks not run. Describe migration or compatibility
impact when applicable.

- [ ] Added or updated tests for nontrivial behavior, or explained why none are needed.
- [ ] Checked the diff for credentials, account records, and private data.
- [ ] Updated relevant documentation and preserved third-party notices.
